semiconductor_relevance: High — Amaya Co., Ltd. specializes in atmospheric pressure CVD equipment and photomask cleaning equipment, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Amaya Co., Ltd. provides advanced atmospheric pressure CVD equipment for oxide film deposition and photomask cleaning solutions tailored for semiconductor applications. Their offerings include continuous, single-wafer, and batch type systems designed to enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs.
capabilities: Atmospheric Pressure CVD equipment for oxide film deposition
Photomask cleaning equipment using functional water
Mist CVD equipment for oxide semiconductors and functional amorphous films (under development)
